Real platform UI remains host-owned; this contract is not a fake dialog or executed native integration.

Opt-in content appearance only; native TextField/SecureField own editing, selection, keyboard and accessibility. The consumer owns labels, text, focus bindings and validation. Native inline rows and system security dialogs retain platform appearance.

capture_contract.minimum_matrix: default light + dark on each target platform
capture_contract.other_states: Explicit test methods only; default evidence does not certify every state.
capture_contract.screen_families: Reuse existing LayeredKitPreviewUITests native family captures; not duplicated here.
capture_contract.private_primitives: Observe internal implementation via the real public containing component; no fabricated standalone UI.

host_system_setting_required.reason: SwiftUI colorSchemeContrast is read-only. Requires the real platform Increase Contrast accessibility setting and independently verified native evidence; no launch-state override is provided.
